description: stablenet crossing its own boho fork by restart: 4 bp run the pre-fork build, and every node is relaunched well before the fork block on the post-fork one. One chain, one build at a time — the nodes keep their databases and their work, and only the executable changes. The fork's own content (govMinter v2) is in the genesis from block 0; the block it activates on comes from the upgrade declaration. GSTABLE_POSTFORK_BIN names the build that knows boho; with one build available it can be the same path, which still exercises the restart. Used by 1 case.
